standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that an irreducible component of a Noetherian space meets a locally closed piece in a set containing an open of the whole space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 5859)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the open subset used to split the partition.

core_obligations: Find a piece of the partition: for an irreducible component of the space some piece has that component inside its closure, so the intersection of the component with that piece contains an open of the space (proof lines 5853-5859)

Split the partition along that open: writing the complement as the disjoint union of the traces inside and outside the closure of the open subset, the complement is closed and strictly smaller, and the traces inside the closure of the open are exactly the boundary of the open (proof lines 5860-5871)

Noetherian induction: the refined partition of the strictly smaller closed complement is refined by a finite good stratification, and adjoining the open subset gives the required finite good stratification of the whole space (proof lines 5872-5876)
proof_roadmap: 取不可约分支 Z，则存在 i 使 Z ⊂ 闭包(X_i)，且 X_i 局部闭 ⇒ Z ∩ X_i 含 Z 的开集 ⇒ 含 X 的开集 U（由 Noetherian 引理）。
把 X_i 拆成 U、X_i^1 = (X_i ∖ U) ∩ 闭包(U)、X_i^2 = (X_i ∖ U) ∩ 闭包(U)^c，其余 X_{i'} 同样拆分；则 X ∖ U 是闭且严格更小的分划，且 闭包(U) ∖ U = ∪ X_l^1。
对 X ∖ U 用 Noetherian 归纳取得有限好层化，再把 U 并入即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every finite partition of a Noetherian topological space is refined by a finite good stratification (author lemma at source lines 5847-5851, label lemma-noetherian-partition-refined-by-stratification). The proof (source lines 5853-5877) finds an open subset of the space inside one piece along an irreducible component, splits the partition along that open subset so that the complement is a strictly smaller closed subset, and concludes by Noetherian induction (proof lines 5853-5876). The splitting of the partition and the induction are the content. H3.
